_about: Curated, human-verified clause store for the 4 bundled policy brochures. Text is transcribed (near-verbatim) from the PDF page cited. 'page' = PDF page number (1-based). type: base | optional | plan_specific | exclusion | info. 'condition_terms': a claim relying on this clause must mention at least one of these terms, otherwise the auditor flags CONDITION_OMITTED.

clauses.text: Infinite Benefit: 100% of base sum insured added. Accumulate 100% of base sum insured year after year, infinite times, irrespective of claims made.
clauses.pitch: Infinite Benefit adds 100% of base sum insured every policy year, irrespective of claims, with no cap on accumulation.

clauses.text: Automatic Restore Benefit (Unlimited Times): Every time you claim, your base cover is restored, as many times as needed.
clauses.pitch: Automatic Restore refills the base cover every time a claim is made, unlimited times.

clauses.text: Secure Benefit 2X: 2X coverage from Day 1. Your base cover doubles instantly, at no extra cost.
clauses.pitch: Secure Benefit gives 2X coverage from Day 1 at no extra cost.

clauses.text: Protect Benefit: Zero deductions on listed non-medical expenses to maximise your claim during hospitalisation.
clauses.pitch: Protect Benefit means zero deductions on listed non-medical expenses during hospitalisation.

clauses.text: Illustration: a 35-year-old buys INR 10 lakhs base cover for his family and pays a premium of INR 22,616. INR 22,616 premium is for Optima Secure+ plan including favourable claims experience discount and lifetime discount, for a 2-member Family Floater policy with age 35 years and 30 years.
clauses.pitch: Illustrative premium: INR 22,616 for INR 10 lakh base cover (2-member family floater, ages 35 and 30, after discounts).

clauses.text: 60 & 180 Days Pre & Post Hospitalisation Covered: Optima Secure+ covers medical expenses for 60 days pre and 180 days post hospitalisation.
clauses.pitch: Covers 60 days pre- and 180 days post-hospitalisation medical expenses.

clauses.text: Home Healthcare: This policy covers treatment availed from the comfort of your home on cashless basis. Home health care available only on cashless basis in select cities only.
clauses.pitch: Home Healthcare is covered on a cashless basis in select cities.

clauses.text: Daily Cash For Shared Room: daily cash of INR 800 per day up to a maximum of INR 4,800 on hospitalisation when you choose a shared accommodation in a network hospital, and the hospitalisation period exceeds 48 hours.
clauses.condition: Shared room in a network hospital, hospitalisation over 48 hours.
clauses.pitch: Daily cash of INR 800/day (max INR 4,800) for choosing a shared room in a network hospital for stays over 48 hours.

clauses.text: Preventive health check-up benefits post completion of every policy year, irrespective of claim status. Sub-limit by Base Sum Insured 10 L / 15 L / 20 L, 25 L & 50 L / 100 L & 200 L: Individual Policy (per insured) 2,000 / 4,000 / 5,000 / 8,000; Floater Policy (per policy) 5,000 / 8,000 / 10,000 / 15,000.
clauses.pitch: Preventive health check-up after every policy year, irrespective of claims (INR 2,000 to 8,000 per insured on individual policies, by sum insured).

clauses.text: E-Opinion: Get e-opinion on 51 critical illnesses through network providers in India. E-Opinion for Critical Illness: once per insured person (for 51 defined major illnesses).
clauses.pitch: E-opinion on 51 critical illnesses through network providers, once per insured person.

clauses.text: Hospitalisation Expenses: covers medical expenses incurred at the time of hospitalisation that include room rent at actuals, ICU expenses, nursing expenses, surgeon's fee, road ambulance charges and so on. It also covers all day care treatments that require hospitalisation for less than 24 hours.
clauses.pitch: Hospitalisation cover includes room rent at actuals, ICU, nursing, surgeon's fees and all day care treatments.

clauses.text: AYUSH Treatment: covers in-patient care treatment expenses for Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy.
clauses.pitch: In-patient AYUSH treatment is covered.

clauses.text: Domiciliary Hospitalisation: Secures all medical expenses during domiciliary hospitalisation. Organ Donor Expenses: reimbursements for medical expenses incurred for organ donor's in-patient treatment for harvesting of the organ donated.
clauses.pitch: Domiciliary hospitalisation and organ donor expenses are covered.

clauses.text: Emergency Ambulance: Road: Up to sum insured. Air: Up to INR 5,00,000. The policy pays for air ambulance transportation services during your emergency needs.
clauses.pitch: Emergency ambulance: road up to sum insured, air ambulance up to INR 5,00,000.

clauses.text: Aggregate Deductible - Value Buy: A deductible is an amount you agree to pay at the time of claim once in a policy year. You can choose from deductible options (INR 25,000 to 5,00,000) and enjoy up to 65% discount on your premium. Easy Switch: option to waive the opted deductible at renewal post completion of 5 years.
clauses.pitch: Optional aggregate deductible (INR 25,000 to 5,00,000) can cut premium by up to 65%.

clauses.text: ABCD Chronic Care (add-on): Covers hospitalisation expenses for Asthma, Blood pressure, Cholesterol and Diabetes from the 31st day.
clauses.pitch: Optional ABCD Chronic Care add-on covers hospitalisation for asthma, blood pressure, cholesterol and diabetes from the 31st day.

clauses.text: Optima Wellbeing (Add-on): Covers various outpatient benefits. my: health Hospital Cash Benefit (Add-on): per day daily cash amount for each completed day of hospitalisation.
clauses.pitch: Optional Optima Wellbeing add-on covers outpatient benefits; optional Hospital Cash add-on pays daily cash.

clauses.text: Individual Personal Accident Rider (only for the insured proposer): Lumpsum payout in case of an unfortunate Accidental Death or Permanent Disability. my: health Critical Illness: Lumpsum payout on diagnosis of a listed critical illness. Serious Illness Booster: critical illness add-on on indemnity basis with double sum insured.
clauses.pitch: Optional Personal Accident rider (proposer only) and Critical Illness add-ons pay lump sums.

clauses.text: Parenthood (add-on): Covers maternity expenses, embryo storage costs and IVF treatments. For additional covers, additional premium will be charged.
clauses.pitch: Maternity, embryo storage and IVF are available only through the optional Parenthood add-on.

clauses.text: Lifetime Discount: additional 5% for first time buyers if all insured persons are 35 years or below. Favourable Claims Experience Discount: up to 21% as a first-time buyer and up to 18% on renewal. Loyalty Discount 2.5%. Family Discount: 10% if two or more family members are covered under the individual policy option. Long-term Discount: 6% for a 2-year term and 8% for 3-year and above.
clauses.pitch: Discounts include 10% family discount (individual option) and 6% / 8% long-term discounts for 2- and 3-year terms.

clauses.text: Choose base coverage from INR 10/15/20/25/50/100/200 Lakhs. Family Floater: maximum of 4 adults and 6 children. Individual Policy: maximum of 6 adults and 6 children. Tenure 1/2/3/4/5 years. Premium in instalments: monthly, quarterly, half-yearly. Adults can be a combination of self, spouse, parents and parents-in-law.
clauses.pitch: Base cover from INR 10 lakh to 200 lakh; family floater up to 4 adults and 6 children, including parents and parents-in-law.

clauses.text: Room Rent: At actuals. Hospitalisation Expenses, AYUSH Treatment, Home Healthcare, Organ Donor Expenses, Pre-Hospitalisation (60 days), Post-Hospitalisation (180 days): Up to sum insured. Automatic Restore Benefit: Up to 100% of base sum insured, for any illness, for any insured person, unlimited times in a policy year.
clauses.pitch: Room rent is paid at actuals, with no room-category cap.

clauses.text: Lifelong Renewal. Cashless treatment across 16,000 cashless healthcare provider network. No Geography-Based Co-payment: treated in any city across India without any co-payment. No Claim-based Loading: no loading of renewal premium just because you claimed.
clauses.pitch: No geography-based co-payment and no claim-based loading on renewal premium.

clauses.text: Life-long renewal regardless of health status or previous claims, except fraud or misrepresentation. Waiting periods reduce by 1 year for every continuous policy year completed. Portability from another insurer with accrued benefits at renewal, subject to underwriting.
clauses.pitch: Lifelong renewal; waiting periods reduce by 1 year for every continuous policy year.

clauses.text: 16,000 cashless healthcare provider network. 98% health claims payout ratio. INR 21,700 cr. worth health claims paid in last 15 years. 1.5 cr. lives insured under health insurance. 24x7 call centre servicing in 10 languages.
clauses.pitch: 16,000 cashless healthcare providers and a 98% health claims payout ratio.

clauses.text: Standard Exclusions: Investigation and evaluation purposes, obesity control, cosmetic surgery, hazardous sports, breach of law, alcoholism, drug or substance abuse, unproven treatments, sterility and infertility, maternity.
clauses.pitch: Standard exclusions include maternity, infertility, cosmetic surgery, obesity control and hazardous sports.

clauses.text: Waiting Periods: 30 days initial waiting period, 24 months waiting period on specific illnesses and surgical procedures, 36 months waiting period on pre-existing diseases.
clauses.pitch: Waiting periods: 30 days initial, 24 months for specific illnesses, 36 months for pre-existing diseases.

clauses.text: No sub-limits on Modern or Conventional Treatments. Unlimited Automatic Recharge for Related & Unrelated Illnesses. Unlimited E-consultation with General Physician. Up to 60 days pre-hospitalization and 180 days post-hospitalization coverage. Pay premium as per your city of residence. AYUSH treatment coverage up to 100% of Sum Insured. Coverage for treatment expenses at home up to 100% of Sum Insured under Domiciliary Hospitalization.
clauses.pitch: No sub-limits on modern or conventional treatments, with unlimited automatic recharge for related and unrelated illnesses.

clauses.text: Get bonus unlimited times on base Sum Insured, unaffected by claims made. This benefit is offered through Cumulative Bonus Booster under add-on policy 'Care Advanced'. This is an optional benefit and available on payment of additional premium.
clauses.pitch: Optional Care Advanced add-on (Cumulative Bonus Booster) adds bonus on base sum insured unlimited times, unaffected by claims.

clauses.text: Road Ambulance Cover: For SI below INR 15 lac - up to INR 10,000; For SI INR 15 lac and above - up to SI. (100% of SI available only for INR 15 Lakh and above SI on road ambulance.)
clauses.condition: Up to SI only when SI is INR 15 lakh or above; otherwise capped at INR 10,000.
clauses.pitch: Road ambulance is covered up to sum insured for SI of INR 15 lakh and above (up to INR 10,000 below that).

clauses.text: Sum Insured (annual): 5L / 7L / 10L / 15L / 25L / 50L / 100L. Entry age minimum: Adult 18 years, Child 90 days; maximum: Adult lifelong, Child 24 years. Cover type: Individual max. up to 6 persons; Floater max. up to 2A2C. Tenure options 1/2/3 years. Premium priced across 7 city zones.
clauses.pitch: Sum insured from INR 5 lakh to 100 lakh, lifelong entry age for adults, 1/2/3-year tenure.

clauses.text: Who Are Covered: Self, Spouse / Live-in partner / Same sex partner, Son, Daughter, Father, Mother, Mother-in-law, Father-in-law, Grand father, Grand mother.
clauses.pitch: Covers self, spouse or partner (including same-sex), children, parents, parents-in-law and grandparents.

clauses.text: In-Patient Care: Up to SI. Day Care Treatment: All day care procedures. Modern Treatment: Up to SI. Room Rent: Up to SI. ICU Cover: Up to SI. Pre-Hospitalization: Up to SI, 60 days prior to hospitalization. Post Hospitalization: Up to SI, 180 days after discharge. AYUSH Treatment: Up to SI. Domiciliary Hospitalization: Up to SI. Organ Donor Cover: Up to SI.
clauses.pitch: Room rent, ICU, modern treatments and AYUSH are covered up to sum insured, with 60/180 days pre/post-hospitalisation.

clauses.text: Cumulative Bonus: 50% of SI per year, max. up to 100% of SI; shall not reduce in case of claim.
clauses.pitch: Cumulative bonus of 50% of SI per year, up to 100% of SI, which does not reduce on a claim.

clauses.text: Unlimited Automatic Recharge: Available for unlimited times for unrelated or same illness. Unlimited E-Consultations: Available for consultations with general physicians (as per the empanelled list of general physicians within the company network).
clauses.pitch: Unlimited automatic recharge for the same or unrelated illness, and unlimited e-consultations with general physicians.

clauses.text: Health Services: Health Portal - Doctor on chat, healthy tips reminder. Discount Connect - Discounts on services such as consultations, diagnostics, maternity etc. at network. Welcome Discount: up to 7.5% discount on premium for new policy buyers (7.5% in first year, 5% in second year).
clauses.pitch: Welcome discount of 7.5% in year one and 5% in year two for new buyers.

clauses.text: Care OPD (add-on policy, available on payment of additional premium): Max. 4 physical consultations with general physician and max. 4 with 14 specified specialists, up to INR 500 per consultation per insured in a policy year; higher option up to INR 1,000 (GP, 10% co-payment) and INR 2,000 (specialists, 5% co-payment).
clauses.pitch: Optional Care OPD add-on covers up to 4 GP and 4 specialist physical consultations a year.

clauses.text: Optional Benefits (Care Supreme, on payment of additional premium): Cumulative Bonus Super up to 100% of SI per year, max. up to 500% of Sum Insured. Annual Health Check-up once per Insured per policy year. Air Ambulance up to INR 5 lacs per year.
clauses.pitch: Optional benefits include annual health check-up, air ambulance up to INR 5 lakh a year, and Cumulative Bonus Super up to 500% of SI.

clauses.text: Wellness Benefit (optional cover on payment of additional premium): renewal discount for recording 10,000 steps or more in a day - 270 days: 30%, 240 days: 20%, 180 days: 15%, 120 days: 10%, less than 120: 0%. Also access to digital fitness coaching, AI fitness coaching and nutritionist / wellness coach.
clauses.pitch: Optional Wellness Benefit earns up to 30% renewal discount for 270 days of 10,000+ steps.

clauses.text: Instant Cover (optional, additional premium): For Hypertension, Diabetes, Hyperlipidemia or Asthma post initial wait period of 30 days; under Care Advanced also Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), Obesity, Coronary Artery Disease with PTCA done prior to 1 year.
clauses.pitch: Optional Instant Cover covers diabetes, hypertension, hyperlipidemia and asthma after a 30-day wait.

clauses.text: Wait Periods: Initial Wait Period 30 days (not applicable on accident cases). Named Ailment 24 months. Pre-Existing Diseases 36 months.
clauses.pitch: Waiting periods: 30 days initial (not for accidents), 24 months named ailments, 36 months pre-existing diseases.

clauses.text: Claim Shield (optional): Coverage of expense related to listed 68 non-payable items during hospitalization. Claim Shield+ (Care Advanced add-on): items non-payable per annexure I (list I-IV) covered up to Sum Insured. Modification of PED Wait Period (optional): PED wait period modified to 1 or 2 years. Be-Fit (optional): unlimited access to fitness centres.
clauses.pitch: Optional Claim Shield covers 68 listed non-payable items; optional PED wait reduction to 1 or 2 years.

clauses.text: Unlimited Care (Care Advanced add-on, additional premium): Any one claim during the lifetime of the policy without any limit on sum insured. Cumulative Bonus Booster: 100% of Base Sum Insured per year irrespective of claim - unlimited times on continuous renewal.
clauses.pitch: Optional Care Advanced add-on offers one lifetime claim without any sum insured limit.

clauses.text: Claim Protect: takes care of 100% out-of-pocket non-medical expenses (as per the lists under Annexure I of the Policy Wording), for items like gloves, gown, face mask and more. Get up to 100% of your hospital bills covered (up to your Sum Insured). Benefits may vary as per the plan and SI opted.
clauses.pitch: Claim Protect covers listed non-medical items such as gloves and masks, so up to 100% of the hospital bill is covered up to sum insured.

clauses.text: Earn up to 100% HealthReturns every year even if you claim, usable for renewal premiums, diagnostic test costs, cost for health emergencies and medical bills. Earn by completing Health Assessment, getting Green Healthy Heart Score, walking 10,000 steps a day or burning 300 calories per session on the Activ Health app. The amount of HealthReturns is indicative and subject to Product and Health Risk Assessment.
clauses.pitch: Employees can earn up to 100% HealthReturns a year (indicative) by staying active, even if they claim.

clauses.text: No capping on hospitalization expenses, procedures and benefits such as room rent, ICU charges, road ambulance cover, day care treatments, organ donor expenses, up to your Base Sum Insured. Limitless means there are no sub-limits and every base benefit is covered up to Sum Insured.
clauses.pitch: No sub-limits: room rent, ICU, road ambulance and day care are covered up to base sum insured.

clauses.text: Super Reload: With Activ One, we will refill your cover up to 100% of your Base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year.
clauses.pitch: Super Reload refills cover up to 100% of base sum insured, unlimited times in a policy year.

clauses.text: Activ One VIP+ plan: Global Cover for emergency and planned treatments abroad (any illness / injury). Enhanced International and Domestic Sum Insured from INR 50 Lacs to INR 6 Crores (combined). International and Domestic Maternity Cover: For BSI INR 50 Lacs and 75 Lacs - Domestic Maternity up to INR 1 Lac; For BSI INR 1 Cr and above - worldwide Maternity up to INR 2 Lacs.
clauses.condition: Only under the VIP+ plan; maternity limits depend on base sum insured.
clauses.pitch: Under the VIP+ plan: global cover for emergency and planned treatment abroad (any illness or injury), with sum insured from INR 50 lakh to INR 6 crore.

clauses.text: Activ One SAVR plan: save up to INR 50,000 every year on taxes by declaring your parents or parents-in-law under your policy. Hospi Cash of INR 500 per day (maximum up to 30 days) for the hospitalization of your parents / parents-in-law. Tax benefits are subject to changes in tax laws.
clauses.pitch: Under the SAVR plan: cover parents or parents-in-law with INR 500/day hospital cash (up to 30 days).

clauses.text: ABCD++: Day 1 cover for listed 7 chronic conditions with zero waiting period: Asthma, High Blood Pressure, High Cholesterol, Diabetes, Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease, Obesity, Coronary Artery Disease (PTCA done prior to 1 year). Benefits may vary as per the plan and SI opted.
clauses.pitch: Day 1 cover with zero waiting period for 7 listed chronic conditions, including diabetes, high blood pressure and asthma.

clauses.text: Advanced Health Checkup including Computed Tomography Angiography (CTA) and Positron Emission Tomography (PET) Scan at no extra cost.
clauses.pitch: Advanced health check-up including CTA and PET scan at no extra cost.

clauses.text: Super Credit: your Sum Insured inflates to 6 times the size of your Base Sum Insured by the 6th year of your policy irrespective of whether you claim. Inflation-proof health insurance plan.
clauses.pitch: Super Credit grows the sum insured to 6X base sum insured by year 6, irrespective of claims.

clauses.text: Wide range of Sum Insured from INR 5 lacs to INR 6 crores. Three zone premium: pay the premium as per the city you reside in. No maximum capping on entry age. Age-banded premium: premium increases only after certain age bands, not every year. Cover legally married spouse or live-in partner (same or opposite sex).
clauses.pitch: Sum insured from INR 5 lakh to INR 6 crore, with no maximum entry age and age-banded premiums.

clauses.text: Benefits may vary as per the plan and SI opted, please refer the Product Benefit Table / Policy wordings. In case of any conflict between the brochure and the Policy Wording, the Policy Wording shall prevail.
clauses.pitch: Benefits vary by plan and sum insured; policy wording prevails.

clauses.text: Variants Platinum+ and Titanium+. Base Sum Insured (INR): 5 Lacs, 7.5 Lacs, 10 Lacs, 15 Lacs, 20 Lacs, 25 Lacs, 50 Lacs, 100 Lacs.
clauses.pitch: Two variants (Platinum+ and Titanium+) with base sum insured from INR 5 lakh to 100 lakh.

clauses.text: In-patient Care (including AYUSH): Covered up to Sum Insured. Pre-Hospitalisation 60 Days, Post-Hospitalisation 180 Days: Covered up to Sum Insured. Modern Treatments, Home Care / Domiciliary, Organ Donor: Covered up to Sum Insured. Minimum 24 hours of hospitalisation required for AYUSH treatment in an AYUSH Hospital.
clauses.pitch: In-patient care including AYUSH, modern treatments and home care covered up to sum insured, with 60/180 days pre/post-hospitalisation.

clauses.text: Ambulance: Road Ambulance covered up to Sum Insured; Air Ambulance up to INR 2,50,000 per Hospitalisation.
clauses.pitch: Road ambulance up to sum insured and air ambulance up to INR 2,50,000 per hospitalisation.

clauses.text: Annual Health Checkup (Day 1): for defined list of tests; up to INR 500 for every INR 1 Lac Base Sum Insured (Individual: Maximum INR 5,000 per Insured; Family Floater: Maximum INR 10,000 per policy). Available only on cashless with network provider.
clauses.pitch: Day 1 annual health check-up worth INR 500 per INR 1 lakh of base sum insured (max INR 5,000 per insured), cashless at network providers.

clauses.text: ReAssure+: 1st claim triggers ReAssure+, forever. It is Unlimited. Each claim will be up to the Base Sum Insured. Pay the premium as per your entry age, till a claim is paid (the product may be repriced as per IRDAI guidelines).
clauses.pitch: ReAssure+ gives unlimited reinstatement after the first claim (each claim up to base SI), and premium stays at entry age until a claim is paid.

clauses.text: Booster+: Platinum+ - Unutilised Base Sum Insured carries forward to the next policy year, maximum up to 5 times of Base Sum Insured. Titanium+ - Unutilised Base Sum Insured carries forward to the next policy year, maximum up to 10 times of Base Sum Insured.
clauses.condition: Only unutilised sum insured carries forward; 5X on Platinum+, 10X on Titanium+.
clauses.pitch: Booster+ carries forward unutilised base sum insured, up to 5X (Platinum+) or 10X (Titanium+).

clauses.text: Live Healthy: Up to 30% discount on premium at the time of Renewal. Eligible: all members except son/daughter under a Family Floater policy, and any member of age at least 18 years under an Individual policy.
clauses.pitch: Live Healthy offers up to 30% renewal premium discount for adult members.

clauses.text: Shared Accommodation: Up to INR 15 Lac Base Sum Insured: INR 800 per day; Maximum INR 4,800. Above INR 15 Lac Base Sum Insured: INR 1,000 per day; Maximum INR 6,000.
clauses.pitch: Shared accommodation cash of INR 800 to 1,000 per day (max INR 4,800 to 6,000), depending on sum insured.

clauses.text: Second Medical Opinion: Once for any condition in a Policy Year. e-consultation: Unlimited e-consultation within our network.
clauses.pitch: Unlimited e-consultations within network and a second medical opinion once per condition per year.

clauses.text: Optional Benefits: Hospital Cash - up to INR 5 Lac BSI: INR 1,000/day; INR 7.5 Lacs to INR 15 Lac: INR 2,000/day; above 15 Lac: INR 4,000/day (minimum 48 hrs continuous hospitalisation, max 30 days per policy year). Personal Accident: choose from 1X / 2X / 3X / 4X / 5X of base sum insured, maximum up to INR 1 Crore.
clauses.pitch: Optional hospital cash (INR 1,000 to 4,000/day) and optional personal accident cover up to 5X base SI (max INR 1 crore).

clauses.text: Safeguard: Claim Safeguard - non-payable items covered (as per list I of Annexure I); Booster+ Safeguard - no impact on Booster+ if claim in a policy year is less than INR 50,000; Sum Insured Safeguard - CPI linked increase in Base Sum Insured. Safeguard+: non-payable items covered as per list I, II, III, IV of Annexure I; no impact on Booster+ if claim less than INR 1,00,000; CPI linked increase. Safeguard+ is an optional benefit and is available on payment of an extra premium.
clauses.pitch: Optional Safeguard / Safeguard+ covers non-payable items and adds a CPI-linked increase in base sum insured.

clauses.text: Annual Aggregate Deductible: small deductibles to choose from - INR 20,000; INR 30,000; INR 50,000; INR 1,00,000. Tiered Network (rider): Get 15% discount on Premium. A co-payment of 20% would apply if treatment taken in a non-Tiered Network Hospital.
clauses.pitch: Optional Tiered Network rider gives 15% premium discount, with 20% co-payment outside the tiered network.

clauses.text: 30 Mins Cashless Claim Processing (pre-authorisation requests within 30 minutes, subject to receiving all documents). 10,000+ Network Hospitals (approximate, subject to change). 24X7 Customer Service. 2 Crore+ Lives Covered.
clauses.pitch: Cashless pre-authorisation within 30 minutes and 10,000+ network hospitals.
